title: Longitudinal Experience Registry — Public-Safe Edition

privacy.reason: Minimize re-identification and sensitive personal disclosure while preserving analytic structure.

limitations: The records document reported experiences and analyst coding, not independently verified external events.
Twenty-two subphases are nested within eight primary encounters and are not independent encounters.
All imported subphases share the same four-category assignment, which inflates those expanded totals.
Life periods are unequal exposure windows and counts are not duration-normalized incidence rates.
The public-safe edition omits source narratives and therefore cannot support independent recoding.

categories.Definition: Presence of non-human or non-ordinary intelligences, visual or non-visual.
OBE, lucidity, bilocation, hypnagogic transitions, altered awareness.
Movement through structures, relocation, teleportation-like transitions.
Rings, toroids, fields, membranes, structured light or energy.
Multiple overlapping or nested perceptual environments.
Time distortion, foresight, non-linear temporal experience.
Physical marks, energetic impacts, or physiological resonance from encounters.
Non-linguistic communicative actions with clear semantic content.
Synthetic, constructed, or altered spatial environments.
Fully coherent transitions into structured non-3D spaces or 'orientation' scenes.

stages.Description: Childhood liminal experiences, silhouettes, fear, and basic presence phenomena.
Adolescent presence states, dread, and boundary-testing encounters.
Early-adult OBEs, tethering, and layered-room or interference experiences.
Mid-life symbolic gestures, geometric motifs, and meaning-rich episodes.
Post-2019 guided transitions, technical or craft-related demonstrations.
High-coherence 4D orientation events and structured reception spaces.

life_periods.Description: Early adulthood OBEs and flight experiences.
Intense OBEs, layered rooms, emergent interference.
High density of structured encounters and physical effects.
High-coherence 4D orientation, training, and craft-linked scenes.
